read.title: Spring Campaign Results
read.text:
Our spring sunscreen campaign ran for four weeks on Instagram and TikTok. In total, we reached 1.8 million people and got 5.2 million impressions.

Creator videos clearly outperformed our own brand posts. They had three times more engagement and a ROAS of 4.1, compared with 2.3 for regular ads.

Going forward, we will move 30 percent of the ad budget to creator content and test shorter videos under 15 seconds.

write.en: Write a short message to your manager about last month's social media campaign: one key number, what worked, and the next step.
write.model:
Hi Jenny,

Here is a quick update on our October campaign. We reached 900,000 people, and creator videos outperformed our regular posts by 60 percent in engagement. Going forward, we will work with five more creators and shift part of the ad budget to short videos.

Thanks,
Minsu
